$comment: The region contract. Every key a storefront can vary lives here and nowhere else. A region file may only use keys defined below; the compiler rejects unknown keys and type mismatches, so a typo fails the build instead of silently rendering an empty string.

id.description: Folder name and build target, e.g. uk

geo_countries.description: ISO country codes routed to this storefront

published.description: Storefront is live. Unpublished regions still compile and can be previewed, but are never advertised to search engines or used as a geo-redirect target.

free_shipping_threshold_cents.description: Cart total in cents unlocking free shipping

shipping_cost_cents.description: Shipping charge in cents below the threshold

logo_url.description: Absolute URL of the logo used in transactional UI

hero_video_url.description: Fallback hero video when the section has no upload

category_label_1.description: First hero category label, e.g. VIBES

category_label_2.description: Second hero category label, e.g. OCCASIONS

social.description: Social profile URLs keyed by network

trustpilot.description: Per-region Trustpilot. { enabled, embed, url, businessunit_id, template_id, locale, height }. enabled:false renders nothing at all — no slots, no script, no CSS. embed:"app" ships the two slots and lets the Trustpilot Shopify app inject the widget, which is what the USA storefront does. embed:"widget" makes the theme render the widget itself from businessunit_id/template_id/locale, for a region with a Trustpilot account but no app installed.

myshopify_domain.description: The Shopify store that serves this region, e.g. scentspired.myshopify.com. Used by npm run dev:<region> so each region previews against its own store.

dev_port.description: Local port for npm run dev:<region>. Each region gets its own so several can run at once; without this they all fight over 9292.

analytics.description: Per-region Google tags. { ga4_id, ga4_password_page_id, google_site_verification }. An empty string renders no tag at all. _defaults.json carries the IDs every storefront used at the time of extraction (UK, USA and UAE all shared them), so a new region keeps reporting until it declares its own property.

return_shipping_fee.description: Return shipping fee in major units of this region's currency, published in the product structured data (MerchantReturnPolicy). 4.99 was carried over from the shared template for every region; no returns page states a fee, so confirm it per region.
